thread:
emily: Heads-up: launching new dedicated GPU class 'G6-Max-Q' in AMS regions tonight at 03:00 UTC. This pool is targeted at high-throughput batch inferencing and will use a new 'rotation' reservation model. Details below.

raj: Is this replacing any existing pools or additive?

emily: Additive. We'll shift some burst capacity off older preemptible A100 pools over time, but no forced migrations. Teams keep existing pools unless they opt to migrate.

emily: Summary:
- Regions: ams-1a, ams-1b (initial); EU parity planned next quarter.
- Starting capacity: ~48 cards (scales weekly).
- Reservation mode: rotation (time-sliced guarantees for multiple orgs).
- Priority order: enterprise reserved > dedicated reserved > rotation > burst.

emily: Example CLI to create a rotation reservation:
```
redwood reserve create --pool g6-max-q --region ams --duration 30d --rotation --cards 4 --name "ml-batch-q1"
```

capacity-bot: Live inventory: ams-1a: 26 cards available, ams-1b: 22. Nightly replenish +8 cards at 03:00 UTC.

tamika: Billing implications for rotation reservations?

finance-bot: Rotation billing is prorated at 60% of a full dedicated card rate (reflects time-sliced access). Applies to new rotation reservations from tonight. Existing contracts unchanged. Internal pricing details: https://intra.redwood/gpu-pricing#rotation

michael: Console task: add tooltip explaining rotation windows and billing on reservation flow. I'll schedule a small UI deploy tomorrow.

sara: Note for latency-sensitive production services: do not use rotation reservations for critical low-latency endpoints. Use dedicated/pinned pools instead. We'll add a console nudge.

jake: How does G6-Max-Q perf compare to A100 for FP16/int8?

emily: G6-Max-Q optimized for dense batch throughput. FP16 batch throughput should be similar or better; int8 supported but profile workloads first. We'll publish microbenchmarks and perf notes in docs.

oncall-sre: Maintenance window tonight in ams-1b 02:40-03:10 UTC for host reconfiguration. Rotation reservations will be paused during that window. Avoid critical runs in that period.

raj: Who to contact for migration help from A100 -> G6-Max-Q?

emily: Ping #eng-ml with traces and perf targets. We'll run a mapping review and can propose config/quantization changes.

jake: Any org limits on rotation reservations?

emily: Default soft limit is 5 active rotation reservations per org. Request increases via quota form; capacity team reviews.

capacity-bot: Opt-in command for nightly expansion list: `redwood capacity opt-in --region ams --pool g6-max-q`

tamika: Copy 1. I'll notify infra and procurement about billing changes.

michael: I'll handle the console tooltip deploy and add to release notes.

emily: TL;DR: G6-Max-Q live in AMS tonight, rotation reservations enabled, billing = 60% proration, brief maintenance window. Test on non-critical batches first and ping #eng-ml for migration help. :thumbsup:

sara: Thanks everyone.

oncall-sre: If reservation failures occur during 02:40-03:10 UTC open an incident and tag oncall. We'll post a follow-up summary after maintenance.

emily: Follow-up will include a short playbook and benchmark markdown tomorrow.
